# P30.4 (GO-LIVE.4): post-launch closeout — Cloud SQL scale-down, deferral sweep, launch record, capstone

Implements `docs/tickets/P30.4__post-launch-closeout.md`, the final row of the Round 8 GO-LIVE tail. Stacked on
`devin/p30-3-national-export-and-public-cutover` (PR #135). Requirement ids: SIG-ENG-003 (ADR-107),
SIG-ENG-039 (Appendix F row), SIG-METRIC-008 (launch record framing), SIG-TASK-018 (DRAFT-never-send
re-confirmed). This PR makes no product-code change: it is ops, verification and build memory.

## Summary

- **Cloud SQL scaled down.** `sig-pg` moved `db-custom-2-8192` → **`db-custom-1-3840`** (the smallest
  dedicated-core tier), based on measurements (ADR-107). The patch ran 17:04:04Z → `RUNNABLE` 17:09:02Z.
  Estimated compute ≈ **$101 → ≈ $49/month** (list price, us-central1). The public site is bucket-served, so
  it was unaffected: a real request was served 200 mid-restart. `probe-hosted` was **7/7 green** after the
  restart, and both public URLs were green.
- **A live-ops finding from the restart.** `sig-api` does not reconnect after a DB restart: DB endpoints
  returned 500 until the instances were recycled. They were recycled **on the digest already serving**, and a
  one-minute detour onto `:latest` is recorded (ADR-107 §5, **D-P30.4-1**).
- **Go-live deferrals re-verified.** All 11 rows that P30.1–P30.3 closed were checked against live read-only
  counts and the public manifest. All are still DONE.
- **Sweep.** Every OPEN/PARTIAL row now names its owner, precise blocker and landing (DEFERRALS §
  "P30.4 sweep"). **D-R7.3-BREADTH was not run**: none of its 8 sources has a `CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE` entry
  (checked). Wiring them is new connector code, and the hosted land would write to the spine. D-R7.2-SEND
  stays operator-gated (0 sent). D-P21.7-1 stays deferred (`registered=false`, push refused with exit 3).
  D-P30.3-COUNSEL stays OPEN. The first-principles half of D-R6.1-EVAL stays OPEN.
- **Launch recorded** in `docs/build/reports/LAUNCH_RECORD_2026-09-24.md`.
- **Capstone green** (`docs/build/reports/CAPSTONE_VERIFICATION_2026-09-24.md`). The ACCEPTED-deviations
  readout `docs/build/readouts/ACCEPT-R8.md` (R8-1 … R8-7) is **pending the operator's signature**.
- **`projectStatus` stays `IN-PROGRESS`.** BM-TAIL-03 is not met. The accepted-deviations readout is unsigned, and
  19 engineering deferrals have a backlog home but no scheduled chain row. `nextTicket` is the
  manifest-exhausted sentinel.

## Design decisions

- **Tier.** `db-custom-1-3840`, not `db-g1-small`. g1-small is shared-core with no SLA and has 1.7 GB, which
  does not change the conditions that starved `db-f1-micro`. Measured point reads were unchanged on the new
  tier. The monthly OSM replay is latency-bound and has a 36 h deadline. Revisit triggers are in ADR-107.
- **The sig-api restart used the digest, not `:latest`,** so the restart changed no running code.
- **Engineering follow-ups are not closed and not scheduled here.** A closeout records them and does not
  implement them.
